scope: Freshness check for the dated product examples used by the existing durable lesson. No private or filmed account was used.

sources.title: Projects in ChatGPT
sources.current_observation: Projects keep related chats, files and instructions together; memory and cross-project boundaries depend on project mode, plan and settings.

sources.title: ChatGPT Work and Codex
sources.current_observation: Chat is described for conversational assistance; Work for longer multi-step work and deliverables. Work can use Project context and exposes progress, redirection and approval boundaries.

sources.title: What are projects?
sources.current_observation: Projects remain self-contained workspaces with chat histories, knowledge bases and project instructions.

sources.title: How Microsoft 365 Copilot Notebooks works
sources.current_observation: Notebooks remain scoped workspaces grounded in selected references and instructions rather than the user's entire account or the general web.

sources.title: LLMs Get Lost in Multi-Turn Conversation
sources.current_observation: The historical study still supports the mechanism that early assumptions may persist in simulated multi-turn work. Its reported average is not used as a current universal product-performance claim.

decision: The canonical lesson remains accurate. The animatic uses generic fictional interfaces and durable workflow concepts. Product names appear only in the dated then-versus-now context; no volatile click-path is taught.
release_boundary: Recheck official sources and the authorized filming account before release capture. This receipt authorizes no public binding, filming, publication or deployment.
